name: summarize
description: Summarizes every Claude Code iteration and lets you browse them: files, repos, PRs, reviews, plans, open questions

summarizer.title: Recap summarizer
summarizer.description: heuristic (default): deterministic, no model call, first sentence of the answer or a line built from the iteration facts; haiku: one-line AI summary per iteration

showBand.title: Show recap band
showBand.description: After /summarize, show the latest summary in a one-line band above the prompt
